notes: Modified cash basis school district. No governmental funds receipts/disbursements statement is in the trimmed PDF (only Statement of Net Position p1, Statement of Activities p2, Statement of Assets and Fund Balances p3, and fund budget-and-actual schedules pp4-12), so receipts/disbursements were taken line by line from the fund schedules (General, Depreciation, Employee Benefit, Activities, School Nutrition, Special Building, Student Fee). School Nutrition is included in the governmental funds (no business-type column), so business_type is null. Transfers: General 8000 Transfers (Outgoing) 211,030 = Activities 151,091 + Nutrition 59,939; Depreciation transfer in 145,081 has no matching outflow (see decision_needed); transfers excluded from receipts/disbursements. Statement of activities total disbursements 15,916,028 equals fund disbursements excluding the 211,030 transfer. Statement of activities program receipts 2,921,514 + general receipts 12,741,460 = 15,662,974 = fund receipts excluding transfers 15,517,893 + 145,081 (the unmatched transfer is counted as a receipt there). Roll-forward: 6,317,273 + 15,517,893 - 15,916,028 + 356,111 - 211,030 = 6,064,219. Fund balance statement merges Depreciation (152,053 committed) and Employee Benefit (20,178) into General (3,830,238). Student Fee extracurricular fees receipt line is zero (dash) and not listed. Beginning cash is the beginning net position/fund balances (cash basis). Detail: General Fund budget schedule has only program-level actuals (budget only on totals); fund schedules recorded for all funds, no double counting (only the fund schedules are used as detail). Page mapping: trimmed p1=report p3, p2=p4, p3=p5, p4=p19 ... p12=p27. Read pages 1-12 of 12.

report_discrepancies.note: Transfers in (356,111) exceed transfers out (211,030) by 145,081: Depreciation Fund 'Funds Transfer In' 145,081 (p7) has no matching outflow; General 8000 Transfers 211,030 (p6) = Activities 151,091 + Nutrition 59,939. Statement of Activities (p2) counts the 145,081 as a receipt. Recorded as printed.
